instrument_repairs_made_during_this_task: paper/analysis/compare_ablation.py ADDED. Produces ablation_comparison.json from raw eval_detector reports. consolidate_task1.py was deliberately not reused (it requires a parser report, and there is no parser off-arm). The script refuses to emit a comparison for any state whose off-arm has n_detected == 0 or a non-null depth_map_passed, marking it INVALID and excluding it from all aggregates — the two signatures of the throttle failure and of an ablation flag that did not take. This run excluded 0 states.
caveats: CORPUS TIER: every number here is from the _only_subset tier (AZ 15pp, CA 13pp, CO 10pp, TX 9pp, NV 15pp of 98, KY 8pp of 120), never full documents.

REPORT THE PER-STATE TABLE, NOT THE MEAN. Four of six states are completely unaffected (recall 1.000 in both arms); the entire effect lives in CO and KY. 'Mean recall 1.000 -> 0.961' simultaneously understates CO/KY and overstates AZ/CA/TX/NV. The honest claim is conditional: the depth map matters for documents whose level identity depends on nesting position.

THE ABLATION DOES NOT ISOLATE PASS 1 FROM PROMPT QUALITY. The off-arm still runs the full detection prompt; only the inferred depth map is withheld. This measures the MARGINAL contribution of Pass 1 given everything else, not the value of hierarchy information in general.
NO PARSER NUMBER BELONGS IN AN ABLATION TABLE. The parser never receives a depth map, so Task 1's and Task 2's parser results are unaffected by this flag.

ONE RUN PER STATE, NOT A STABILITY STUDY. CO's golden is 7 elements and KY's 44, so one element moving shifts CO's recall by 0.14. The DIRECTION is corroborated by categorical regression failures, but the magnitudes are single samples. Repetition is Task 5.

CODE ACCURACY DENOMINATORS DIFFER BETWEEN ARMS because code accuracy is graded over matched pairs only and the off-arm matches fewer elements (KY 44 vs 40, CO 7 vs 6). Report matches/total for both arms and never compare the two rates as if they shared a denominator.

NV CODE ACCURACY IMPROVED IN THE OFF-ARM (44/46 -> 45/46) AND THIS IS NOISE. One cell on one state; NV's on-arm code misses are both domain.code arising from _resolve_code grounding, which has no dependence on the depth map. Omit it or label it as sampling noise; it is not evidence the ablation helps.

THE EARLIER KY SMOKE TEST OVER-STATED THE EFFECT AND MUST NOT BE QUOTED. It reported recall 0.886 / sub_strand recall 0.60 / strand precision 0.40 and '6 of 12' Benchmark misclassifications; the recorded run gives 0.909 / 0.700 / 0.500 and 4 of 11. Same phenomenon, smaller magnitude. Quote the recorded numbers.

THE FIRST ATTEMPT'S ARTIFACT IS STILL ON DISK AND IS POISON. INVALID_THROTTLED_detector_nodepthmap.json records five states at recall 0.0 that never ran. It is retained only for the reproducibility narrative. Never quote it, and never merge it with the valid report.

A NON-ZERO EXIT CODE IS AMBIGUOUS. eval_detector exits non-zero both when a regression fails (expected in the off-arm) and when the run throttles (invalid). CO and KY are the former. Always confirm n_detected > 0 and depth_map_passed is null before trusting an off-arm state.

first_attempt_aborted.what_failed: Bedrock returned ThrottlingException: 'Too many tokens per day' partway through the off-arm. The account's DAILY token quota had been exhausted by the Task 1 and Task 2 arms that ran immediately before (35 minutes of Opus detection plus Sonnet parsing). This was NOT a concurrency problem: the run was strictly sequential. A daily cap cannot be avoided by pacing within the same day. MEASURED 2026-08-23T00:45Z: the exhausted quota is MODEL-SPECIFIC to Opus (us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-6-v1). A probe at that moment showed Opus still ThrottlingException while us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6 and us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5 both responded normally. Since the detector runs on Opus and Task 3's off-arm is detector-only, the off-arm is blocked specifically on the Opus daily token budget; parser work (Sonnet) and depth-map work (Haiku) are unaffected.
first_attempt_aborted.why_the_artifact_is_dangerous: INVALID_THROTTLED_detector_nodepthmap.json records six states, and five of them read n_detected=0, matched=0, recall=0.0, precision=0.0. Those zeros are the throttle, NOT the ablation: detect_structure raised, the harness recorded an empty detection, and the grader scored the empty set. Taken at face value the file says removing the depth map drops detector recall from 1.000 to 0.000 on five of six states — a fabricated catastrophic result for the paper's central experiment. This is precisely the failure mode guardrail 6 exists to prevent, which is why the file is renamed with an INVALID_THROTTLED_ prefix and accompanied by DO_NOT_USE.md.
